name: customers
definition: 购买或使用企业产品与服务的交易主体，按客户细分与结算币种区分。 Counterexample: 易与加油站混淆：加油站是交易发生的地点资产，客户是交易主体。 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table customers; provenance: direct source customers

name: gasstations
definition: 隶属于某连锁品牌、位于特定国家并服务特定细分市场的燃油零售站点。 Counterexample: 易与客户混淆：加油站是零售地点，客户是购买方。 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table gasstations; provenance: direct source gasstations

name: products
definition: 可供销售或消耗的燃油及相关商品品类，以描述文本区分。 Counterexample: 易与交易混淆：产品是可售品类，交易是一次购买行为。 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table products; provenance: direct source products

name: transactions
definition: 在某一时点于某加油站由某客户使用某支付卡购买某产品并产生金额与单价的销售事件。 Counterexample: 易与产品混淆：交易是发生的事件，产品是被购买的对象。 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table transactions_1k; provenance: direct source transactions_1k

name: yearmonth
definition: 按客户与月份汇总的消费金额信息记录，用于反映客户在某月的消费总量。 Counterexample: 易与交易混淆：月度消费记录是汇总信息，交易是逐笔明细事件。 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table yearmonth; provenance: direct source yearmonth

name: CustomerSegment
definition: The business segment a customer belongs to (SME, LAM, KAM).

name: Currency
definition: The currency in which a customer's consumption is paid.

name: MonthlyConsumption
definition: The gas consumption recorded per customer per month.

name: YearMonth
definition: The year-month period encoded in the Date column of yearmonth (YYYYMM).

name: TransactionDate
definition: The date and time a transaction took place.

name: TransactionTime
definition: The time of day a transaction took place.

name: GasStationChain
definition: The chain a gas station belongs to.

name: GasStationCountry
definition: The country where a gas station is located.

name: ProductDescription
definition: The description of a product sold at gas stations.

name: TransactionAmount
definition: The monetary amount of a transaction.

name: AnnualConsumption
definition: Total gas consumption of a customer in a given year. Formula: SUM(MonthlyConsumption) WHERE YearMonth BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312. Inputs: MonthlyConsumption = yearmonth.Consumption; YearMonth = yearmonth.Date WHERE Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312

name: PeakMonth
definition: The month with the highest consumption for a customer or segment. Formula: MAX(MonthlyConsumption) per YearMonth. Inputs: MonthlyConsumption = yearmonth.Consumption; YearMonth = yearmonth.Date WHERE Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312

name: HighConsumptionCustomerCount
definition: Number of customers whose monthly consumption exceeds 1000. Formula: COUNT(DISTINCT CustomerID) WHERE MonthlyConsumption > 1000. Inputs: MonthlyConsumption = yearmonth.Consumption

name: TransactionCount
definition: Number of transactions matching a condition. Formula: COUNT(TransactionID). Inputs: TransactionDate = transactions_1k.Date; GasStationCountry = gasstations.Country WHERE Country = 'CZE'

name: CustomerSegment
definition: Analysis by customer business segment.

name: Currency
definition: Analysis by payment currency.
